subject: CAIQ: control alignment worksheet, owner matrix & attestation rhythm
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marta Vega <marta.vega@helixbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: control alignment worksheet, owner matrix & attestation rhythm

Marta —

Thanks for the CAIQ request yesterday. To make the review efficient for both teams, I attached a preliminary control worksheet that maps common CAIQ questions to the controls we can provide, plus a proposed owner matrix and an attestation cadence.

Ask: can you confirm the scope (prod-only vs prod + staging) and whether you require signed attestations for each control or a consolidated attestation per domain? That will change the artifact set we prepare.

Planned next steps from our side:
- We’ll fill the worksheet with control references and point to a single artifact per control where possible (logs, architecture diagrams, policy excerpts).
- Ben will pull runtime retention samples and a short summary of what we retain and for how long.
- Marissa will lead packaging and the final upload to your intake folder.

Attachments: redwood_caiq_control_map_v1.xlsx (worksheet), sso-arch-diagram.png

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-minute sync if that helps.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Marta Vega <marta.vega@helixbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Aug 2025 11:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CAIQ: control alignment worksheet, owner matrix & attestation rhythm

Jordan —

Scope: production systems only. For now we need signed attestations at the domain level (e.g., Identity & Access Management, Logging & Monitoring) rather than a per-control signature. That said, some high-risk controls (crypto key management, tenant isolation) will need detailed artifacts and owner attestations.

Required evidence list:
- Retention policy excerpts and sample runtime logs (redacted)
- Key management diagram and HSM attestations if available
- Mapping of tenant isolation for multi-tenant workloads

We have limited time this quarter — can you confirm you can deliver the packaged folder by EOD Monday? If not, an interim delivery with owner assignments + the retention sample will be fine.

Regards,
Marta
Marta Vega
Senior Compliance Manager — Cloud Risk
HelixBank

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Aug 2025 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ: control alignment worksheet, owner matrix & attestation rhythm

Team — forwarding HelixBank scope confirmation. Bottom line: prod-only; domain-level signed attestations acceptable except for a few high-risk controls we should enrich.

Owner assignments (first pass):
- IAM / HSM: Kimberly (kimberly.park) — please pull key management diagrams, KMS/HSM attestations, and the key rotation policy excerpt.
- Runtime retention / logs: Ben (ben.carter) — we need a 7-day and a 90-day sample, redacted, and a short note on retention SLA.
- Packaging and narrative: Marissa (marissa.cole) — produce the final zip and the domain-level attestation template.

Deadline: EOD Monday 2025-08-11 for the interim bundle (owner matrix + retention samples). If you hit blockers, call me and I will escalate.

Thanks — Jordan
--- Forwarded message attached above ---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: control alignment worksheet, owner matrix & attestation rhythm

Jordan / team —

Attached: retention-policy-sample.pdf (excerpt), runtime-logs-redacted-7d.json (sample stub), runtime-logs-redacted-90d.json (sample stub). The logs are redacted and compressed; I’ve included a short README in the zip describing fields and redaction rules.

Notes: the 90-day sample is aggregated and trimmed to remove tenant identifiers. We can produce a per-tenant export on a scoped call if HelixBank needs it for a specific control check.

If anyone needs me to sign the domain attestation, I can do the Runtime/Logging portion.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: retention-policy-sample.pdf, runtime-logs-redacted-7d.json (stub), runtime-logs-redacted-90d.json (stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: control alignment worksheet, owner matrix & attestation rhythm

All —

Quick status update for HelixBank (I’ll upload these to the shared intake in the morning):
- IAM/HSM: key management diagram exported, rotation policy excerpt attached (redwood_kms_rotation_excerpt.pdf). Crypto team confirmed HSM-backed keys for tenant encryption; I’ll include the HSM attestation PDF once legal signs off.
- Owner matrix: updated the worksheet with names and contact emails (see redwood_caiq_control_map_v1.xlsx, tab "owners").
- Attestation cadence: proposed quarterly domain-level attestation with ad-hoc sign-offs for high-risk controls; draft attestation form is included in the packaging.

Next steps: Marissa — please bundle the interim artifacts (Ben’s logs + my KMS docs + the worksheet) and upload. I’ll be available for a short call with HelixBank if they want a walkthrough.

Kimberly Park
Head of Cloud Security
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_kms_rotation_excerpt.pdf (will upload), redwood_caiq_control_map_v1.xlsx (owners tab updated)
